title: Jigsaw Puzzles
summary: Good morning puzzle makers! During this warm and rainy time (perfect for doing puzzles!!) the tarps are often down. If you are needing to get puzzles and the tarps are down, please ring the doorbell or send me a text/phone call at 727 804-1197 and we can arrange a time for getting them! Have a good day, Jane, the Puzzle Lady!!!
